summary: Instagram's main friction themes include algorithmic curation issues, account management problems, UI/UX frustrations, and privacy concerns.

themes.name: Algorithmic Curation & Content Discovery
themes.description: Users report frustration with the algorithm prioritizing AI-generated content and suggested posts over content from people they follow, making it hard to discover genuine content and follow relationships.
themes.recommendation: Refine algorithm to prioritize user-followed content and reduce AI-generated noise.

themes.name: Account Management & Moderation
themes.description: Users face issues with account suspensions, bans, and notification problems, often without clear explanations or appeal processes.
themes.recommendation: Improve transparency in moderation policies and provide clearer appeal mechanisms.

themes.name: UI/UX & App Functionality
themes.description: Users report broken features like the Places tab removal, notification issues, and video upload problems, impacting core app functionality.
themes.recommendation: Stabilize core features and improve UI/UX for consistent user experience.

themes.name: Privacy & Data Concerns
themes.description: Users express concerns about data harvesting, AI usage, and manipulative algorithms, leading to distrust in the platform.
themes.recommendation: Enhance privacy controls and transparency around data usage.
